label: platform
definition: An asset created to create and deliver products and services for a wide range of customers, giving scale across markets by industrializing smaller components for reuse.

label: market
definition: The set of actual and potential buyers of a product or service.

label: scale
definition: The size or extent of something, especially the ability to serve more customers or markets with the same assets.

label: industrialization
definition: An activity of standardizing and automating components so they can be produced and reused at scale.

label: bundle
definition: A set of products and services packaged and sold together.

label: package
definition: An arrangement of products and services that marketing prepares for sale.

label: sale
definition: An exchange of a product or service for payment.

label: channel
definition: A route through which a product or service reaches its buyers.

label: business-to-consumer
definition: A sales channel in which an organization sells to individual consumers.

label: business-to-business
definition: A sales channel in which an organization sells to other organizations.

label: business-to-business-to-consumer
definition: A sales channel in which an organization sells to consumers through another organization.

label: business-to-government
definition: A sales channel in which an organization sells to government bodies.

label: directive
definition: An instruction that prescribes how something is to be done.
scope_note: Genus of policy, rule, requirement, control, decision model and business logic in the core ontology.

label: phase
definition: A distinct stage in a sequence of change or development.

label: status
definition: The state something is in at a given time.
